left.statement: Before identity is verified do not say arrears, debt, payment, overdue or the product, to anyone including relatives and colleagues.
left.brief_quote: Do not say "arrears", "debt", "payment", "overdue" or the product before identity is verified.

left.statement: Only yes, that's me, speaking or the customer's own name confirms identity; Hello, go ahead, who is this do not. Answer a customer question first; the ask that follows is the second ask.
left.brief_quote: Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name counts as confirmation.

left.statement: If someone else answers, say nothing beyond the opening sentence and do not say why you call; only ask when the customer can be reached. Nobody but the customer may answer security questions or be told about the account, even if they offer to pay.
left.brief_quote: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.

left.statement: Callback window is today or next business day, 10:00 to 20:00 inclusive, and later than now. If the offered time is outside, ask once more; if again outside, do not schedule and close not_reached/no_callback.
left.brief_quote: If that is also outside it, do not schedule.

left.statement: Send date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD; numeric-only dates are read day, month, year; postcode in capitals with one space before the last three characters; phone as four digits.
left.brief_quote: Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.

left.statement: A day_month_swapped hint retry does not count as a wrong answer; ask the customer to say the month as a word.
left.brief_quote: That retry does not count as a wrong answer.

left.statement: After two wrong answers do not state the debt; tell the customer to call the number on their statement or visit a branch.
left.brief_quote: After two wrong answers, do not state the debt.

left.statement: If the customer declines to answer, explain once that the questions protect the account; asking what the call is about counts as declining; a second refusal or second such question closes not_verified/declined.
left.brief_quote: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining.

left.statement: Call get_account only after all security questions pass; name the product in words and state past_due and days_late.
left.brief_quote: After every question passes, call `get_account`.

left.statement: Promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline. If the customer names a weekend or holiday not after the deadline, offer the next business day; if after the deadline, say the latest recordable date is the deadline and offer it; refusal of the deadline is a flat refusal.
left.brief_quote: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

left.statement: Vague date: ask once for the exact day, then propose the deadline.
left.brief_quote: If they still give none, propose the deadline.

left.statement: Never ask how much the customer can pay; the agent proposes every amount. Ask the full amount first. If the full amount is too much, offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue; refusal is a flat refusal.
left.brief_quote: Never ask "how much can you pay?".

left.statement: A customer amount from floor to full inclusive is accepted; below the floor say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once; if not accepted, flat refusal.
left.brief_quote: Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.

left.statement: A date or amount the customer proposes is never a refusal. A flat refusal or non-answer uses one persuasion attempt; a no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal. Do not repeat an offer already refused; when attempts are used up close no_promise/refused.
left.brief_quote: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt.

left.statement: On illness, death in the family or job loss: one short sympathy sentence, no persuasion attempt, offer the support team; accept -> transfer welfare and close transferred/support; decline -> no_promise/hardship. If the customer still names a date or amount, record the promise.
left.brief_quote: say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt.

left.statement: Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any term not in the brief.
left.brief_quote: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.

left.statement: Read product, amount and date back and ask Do you confirm?; call create_promise only after a clear yes. If the customer changes date or amount, recheck and read back again.
left.brief_quote: Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes

left.statement: One promise per product; a recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call. Say it is recorded only after create_promise returns ok true; on failure retry once, then say it could not be recorded and close no_promise/service_error.
left.brief_quote: One promise per product.
